passive.name: Passionate Construction
passive.text:
While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.6/0.75/0.9/1.05/1.2**/s.
When using an **EX Special Attack**, the equipper's Impact is increased by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%** for 10s, stacking up to 2 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Thick Broth
passive.text: For every 10 Energy accumulated, the equipper's Impact is increased by **2/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2%**, stacking up to 8 times. After Energy is consumed, this bonus remains for 8 more seconds. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Behemoth Hunter
passive.text: When the target's HP is no lower than 50%, the equipper inflicts **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** more Daze to the target. When the target's HP is no lower than 75%, this bonus is further increased by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**.

passive.name: Binding Chains
passive.text: When an attack hits an enemy, DMG and Daze from **Basic Attacks** increase by **6/7.5/9/10.5/12%** for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can trigger at most once during each skill. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: In a Flash of Light
passive.text: Increases **Electric DMG** by **15/17.5/20/22/24%**. When the equipper hits an enemy with a **Dodge Counter** or **Assist Attack**, their Energy Generation Rate increases by **18/20.5/23/25/27.5%** for 8s.

substatLine: CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK% > PEN = ATK
skillPriority: Special Attack > Basic Attack > Chain Attack > Dodge > Assist

entries.name: Basic Attack: Turbo Volt
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes. The first 3 hits deal **Physical DMG**, the 4th hit deals **Electric DMG**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Thunderbolt
entries.text:
After unleashing the 3rd hit of the **Basic Attack**, hold down or pause for a short while, and then press Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes a downward strike that deals **Electric DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Slide
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Taser Blast
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Slashes all nearby enemies, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Thunderclap
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Thunderfall
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Flash
entries.text:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Lightning Whirl
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against enemies in front, dealing **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Fork Lightning
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Unleashes an upward slash that deals **Electric DMG**.
This attack launches faster when used after the 3rd hit of the **Basic Attack** or **Basic Attack: Thunderbolt**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Lightning Bolt
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash that deals massive **Electric DMG**.
This attack launches faster when used after the 3rd hit of her **Basic Attack** or **Basic Attack: Thunderbolt**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Electro Engine
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upwards slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Overdrive Engine
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Unleashes a powerful upward slash at enemies in a small area followed by several downward strikes, dealing massive **Electric DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Fluctuating Voltage
entries.text: Launch a **Basic Attack: Thunderbolt**, **Special Attack**, or **EX Special Attack** after the 3rd hit of Anby's **Basic Attack** for an extra **64%** Daze.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Parallel Connection
entries.text:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Anby's **Dodge Counter** hits an enemy, she gains an extra 7.2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

entries.name: Rapid Charge Mode
entries.text: When the 4th hit of Anby's **Basic Attack** hits an enemy, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 12% for 30s.

entries.name: Precision Discharge
entries.text: When **Basic Attack: Thunderbolt** hits a Stunned enemy, its DMG is increased by 30%. When Anby's **EX Special Attack** hits an enemy that is not Stunned, the Daze inflicted is increased by 10%.

entries.name: Well-Disciplined
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Conducting Charge
entries.text:
When Anby launches a **Chain Attack** or uses her **Ultimate**, off-field Electric Agents recover 3 Energy.
For every 12% Energy Generation Rate Anby has, recover an additional 2 Energy, up to a maximum of 6.

entries.name: Street Experience
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Charging Field
entries.text: When Anby uses her **EX Special Attack**, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks). When she hits an enemy with her **Basic Attack** or **Dash Attack**, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing that attack's DMG by 45%.
